name: rebalance_below_min_notional_no_trade
description: A trade that survives band and partial ratio but whose rounded notional is below min_notional is not traded. step_size=0.1 keeps the raw qty at 0.1 contracts, so min_notional (50) is the binding constraint, not rounding. absolute_band_nav=0.0001 and partial_ratio=1.0 are explicit illustrative synthetic values (PENDING).
derivation: equity=10000; AAA mult=1 mark=100, no position, step_size=0.1, min_notional=50. w_cur=0; target=0.001 -> d=0.001; threshold=max(0.25*0.001, 0.0001)=max(0.00025, 0.0001)=0.00025; 0.001 >= 0.00025 -> trade partial_ratio*d=0.001. raw qty=0.001*10000/100=0.1; step 0.1 keeps 0.1; notional=0.1*1*100=10 < 50 -> no trade. orders={}.
